maps.name: Comms â€” Local assistance
maps.description: Hail Captain Vale, coordinate with another Courier, and test communication range.

maps.name: Rescue under threat
maps.description: Helm opens Dispatch and binds displacement. Engineering assigns a repair team; lower shields before Send. Use Comms for the team decision, then recall. An optional medical team can heal injured officers and stabilise severe casualties aboard the stranded ship.

away_missions.reveal_event: Our propulsion is isolated. We have cleared a displacement destination; please send a repair team.

rules.explanation_key: The casualty escaped and the repair party returned safely.
Useful repairs were completed, but the casualty had not escaped when you departed.

fallback.explanation_key: The casualty was lost, personnel were lost, or no restoration objective was completed before departure.

sensor_findings.text_key: The propulsion compartment is isolated. A repair team can restore the damaged drive and service connections.

maps.name: Boarding action
maps.description: Tactical contributes Security and finite shuttles or disposable boarding torpedoes. Support can contribute Medical. Helm coordinates Dispatch and displacement; Comms chooses the objective. The target authors its own defence and capture outcomes.

maps.name: Cruiser combat test
maps.description: Three waves of three pirate raiders. Ten seconds to prepare, thirty seconds between cleared waves. Damage and ammunition persist. Medical is not fitted.

rules.explanation_key: All three pirate waves were defeated.

fallback.explanation_key: You departed before clearing all three waves. Completed waves and deployed craft are recorded.

trees.decision_context: You operate the generator. Compare present power demand and observed stored energy with the offered operating limits. Routine or capped output normally supports the ship; hot mode reduces output to protect machinery when thermal evidence warrants it. Combat output is available when increased supply is justified. Preserve support commitments and judge success from observed supply, not command acceptance.
